_provenance: Captured LIVE 2026-07-24 via pg_net from https://maps.cityofmadison.com/arcgis/rest/services/Planning/Current_Planning_Projects/MapServer/0/query (public planning records; outSR=4326). 7 representative features chosen to cover every status bucket the madison-planning-projects registry entry maps: approved (Final Approval Granted), proposed (In Process, Application Under Review), operating (Approval Granted Completed; Approved Demolished), and the fail-closed exclusions (Approval(s) Expired, Placed on File or Denied). Stable historical cases, not a full-payload snapshot.
